TapFlow requires no user account, contains no ads or behavioral tracking, and executes all automation, color/image matching, and script storage 100% locally on your device. Network access is used strictly for Google Play Billing and optional Firebase Remote Config promo-code verification.
TapFlow operates on an offline-first architecture. All automation data remains inside your device’s private application storage unless you explicitly export it:
Automation sequences, timing settings, and variable definitions stored in a local Room/SQLite database.
Lossless PNG screenshots, sampled pixel coordinates/colors, and crop region bounds captured when you use Live Recording, Live Inspect, or Screenshot Import.
Local execution history and optional failure screenshots stored temporarily on-device and automatically pruned to the latest 50 sessions or 7 days.
UI settings, local 7-day trial timestamps, and redeemed promo window timestamps protected using Android Keystore HMAC-SHA256 verification against tampering.
Exporting a .tapflow backup file via Android’s system file picker saves only script and pipeline logic (Inspect screenshots are strictly excluded).
TapFlow requests only system permissions strictly required for user-initiated automation features:

Dispatches user-configured touch gestures (tap, double tap, long press, multi-touch, swipe), global navigation actions, optional text insertion into focused fields, reads the active foreground app package name for App Match rules & Inspect metadata, and optionally intercepts hardware Volume Down presses for Emergency Stop.
TapFlow NEVER harvests, logs remotely, sells, or transmits screen content, keystrokes, passwords, messages, or personal data.

Used solely during Color Match, Image Match, Live Recording, or Live Inspect. Frames are analyzed on-device in memory (or saved locally in private Inspect/log storage) and are never uploaded or streamed externally.
Renders the floating control dock, coordinate picker, and optional visual touch debug marker over other apps while testing or running scripts.
Populates Launch App, Force Stop App, and App Match pickers and displays app icons/names on Inspect items strictly on-device.
Commands and local broadcast triggers run exclusively on-device with no remote data sharing.
Limited network communication occurs strictly for licensing and optional promo code verification:
Handles in-app purchases and restoration directly through Google Play. TapFlow receives entitlement tokens only and never accesses payment credentials.
Verifies promo_redeem_codes parameters and date windows using an ephemeral Firebase Installations ID with NO Google Analytics behavioral or ad tracking.
You can delete any Script, Pipeline, Inspect Group, Execution Log, or clear cached Inspect images at any time inside Settings.
Execution logs and crash snapshots are automatically pruned at 50 sessions or 7 days.
Uninstalling TapFlow permanently removes all app-private databases, preferences, and saved screenshots (excluding .tapflow backups you manually saved elsewhere).

TapFlow is a general utility application and is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum legal age in your jurisdiction). Because we do not collect user accounts or analytics, we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
